What?
This is a .NET 10 C# Console Agent Application.

Purpose?
Act autonomously and connect to an Outlook Mail Box account and look for spam and delete it.

How?
Run continously until all spam has been removed.

Tech Stack:
C#/.NET 10 Console Application
.NET Aspire
Microsoft Agent Framework
Microsoft Graph .NET SDK
Application Insights

Infrastructure:
Only run locally on Windows 10 for now using Microsoft Agent Framework.
